fields.why: The Table's Pearson chi-square tests (perception level by group) span SPD margins with 3+ levels: race (5), age (4), education (3), gender (3).

The gender variable comes from 'What is your gender?' (female, male, other or unknown including trans and genderqueer), so it is SOGI only; no sex-at-birth component exists, so 'sex' should not be added (A's own equity.dimensions also omit sex, as the mechanical flag notes).
Rule 2: chi-square across r x c tables with the SPD as a margin is an omnibus test; the age and education 'more likely' statements are descriptive, with no pairwise tests reported.
